fusions.name: Thundering Sweep
fusions.desc: Sweeps the haft through a cone 4 tiles ahead of you, dealing 14 damage to everything in it and knocking each enemy back 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Full-Tilt Thrust
fusions.desc: Levels the haft and drives it home, dealing 30 damage and leaving the target 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Ride Abreast
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds, and fights with 1 more power while it holds.

fusions.name: Hayfield Gallop
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 10%.
